sentences.text:
THIS W.P. IS FILED UNDER ARTICLE 226 OF THE CONSTITUTION OF INDIA PRAYING TO DIRECT THE RESPONDENT TO ALLOT ALTERNATE LAND TO THE PETITIONERS PROPORTIONATE TO THE LAND BELONGING TO THEM AND ETC.,
 THIS PETITION, COMING ON FOR PRELIMINARY HEARING IN 'B' GROUP, THIS DAY, ORDER WAS MADE THEREIN AS UNDER:
CORAM: HON'BLE MR JUSTICE E.S.INDIRESH
ORAL ORDER Heard the learned counsel appearing for the parties.

2. In this writ petition, the petitioners have challenged the re-allotment letter dated 18.08.2004 and also the renewal of Lease dated 04.06.2007 in WP.No.11221/2008, disposed of on 02.09.2009 (Annexure-K), wherein, this Court considering the acquisition proceedings initiated by the respondent- authorities vide Notifications dated 02.03.1964 and 18.11.1967 as well as the notification issued under Section 16(2) of the Land Acquisition Act, dismissed the petition therein.

3. In that view of the matter, as this Court has already dismissed the said writ petition in the year 2009, challenging NC: 2024:KHC:50670 the acquisition proceedings and thereafter, directed the respondents to consider the case of the petitioners for payment of compensation.

In that view of the matter, as the acquisition proceedings have reached finality and this Court has already taken decision in the matter as per Annexure-K, I am of the view that the writ petition cannot be accepted for issuance of the writ of mandamus.
It is made clear that, as the award insofar as the determination of compensation has been passed on 18.11.1967 and therefore, prayer made in the writ petition cannot be accepted at this stage.

SD/-
(E.S.INDIRESH) JUDGE PK CT: BHK Smt. Yellamma vs The Commisioner on 9 December, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/109120161/
